title: Houston says 'Mama, I love you' the day before Thanksgiving

tellings.quote: and I was shocked cuz I had never ever heard heard my son say my name he was 17

plain: The day before Thanksgiving in Atlanta, a 17-year-old boy named Houston said "Mama, I love you", and his mother had never once heard him say her name before. His mother, Katie, tells it herself in an episode about the Telepathy Tapes, a documentary by Ky Dickens about children who are said to read minds. She says she was shocked, which for her marks a son who had never said those words finding them at last.
